(Nasdaq: INDI), a Physical AI and automotive market leader with the industry’s broadest multi-modal sensor portfolio, today announced third quarter results for the period ended September 30, 2026. Q3 revenue was $70.2 million, up 31 percent year over year. On a GAAP basis operating loss for the third quarter of 2026 was $39.0 million, compared to $38.3 million a year ago. Non-GAAP operating loss for the third quarter of 2026 was $7.2 million, compared to $11.3 million a year ago, representing continued significant progress towards achieving profitability.
